en: A monochrome historical postcard showing a crowd of people, many in traditional clothing and headscarves, gathered around and reaching up toward what appears to be a damaged or looted bakery shop. The scene is chaotic, with people stretching their arms toward a man or goods at an elevated opening in the building. Printed captions in French and English describe the event, and there is a small imprint indicating the edition/publisher from Salonique.
